source: Classic 1.12 player_levelstats (race, class, level: attributes) and player_classlevelstats (class, level: basehp) of the CMaNGOS classic-db dump ClassicDB_1_12_1_z2815 (~/.wow-forever-tools/cmangos/ClassicDB.sql.gz); attributes made race-neutral with the official simulator's RaceOffsets (sim/core/base_stats.go) and averaged over the class's races. Checked 2026-11-19 against two characters' Blizzard API values (a human paladin at 22: health 742 = basehp 222 + 20 + 10 x (70 - 20) exactly, base attributes 45/32/43/34/36 against 45/32/43/34/37; a gnome mage at 37: health 827 against 817). fightlab/tables.BASE_STAT_TABLE.
